did: Retired the hosted voice service, as the owner chose. Every web build now reads lessons in the browser's own voice, signed in or not, and the phone keeps its own. Settings on the web no longer offers a voice to pick. The voice chosen before is still stored in the browser, unread. The two containers and their proxy are gone from home's setup, and the assurance ledger marks that promise as retired.

calls.title: Keep the old voice choice in the browser rather than drop it
options: keep it stored, unread, and write it back on every save
calls.why: It lived only in the browser, not on home's server, and the record is not ours to drop. The coordinator agreed.
calls.undo: Remove RETIRED_FIELDS from apps/www/src/lib/tenant/settings-repository so a save stops writing the old fields back.

calls.title: Say plainly that a browser or phone voice may run online
options: keep saying nothing you hear is sent anywhere
say some of those voices are online ones, run by whoever made the browser or phone
calls.why: Chrome's Google voices run online, and they now read lesson text on the signed-in desktop too. The old line was no longer true.

left: Stopping the two voice containers on home is the owner's step: docker compose rm -sf openai-edge-tts nginx, from the some-ui checkout.
No clip or screenshot: the change is copy, and a clip needs a push to paulgsc/testing, which this session may not do.
